lines.en: I slide along the corner of the wall

lines.zh: 地板没有响，因为我不重
lines.en: The floor does not creak, I am weightless
Dark places make for better walking

lines.zh: 我从阴影里挪出来一点
lines.en: I edge a little way out of the shadow
That spot behind the door will do

lines.zh: 我一步一步，靠近你的视野
lines.en: I inch closer to the edge of your sight
My face moves along the wall

lines.zh: 绕过这根柱子，你就看不见
lines.en: Around this pillar, and you lose me
I chose the darkest path
I crawl slowly along the beam
I do not walk straight, I curve
One step closer, half a step back
I hide in the corner without moving
The whisper in your ear is me
The floorboard creaked, and it was not me
I wait for you to turn your back
This room is too bright
My face on the wall looks like a stain
My joints are not in the right places
I am counting behind you
I am faster when the moon is full
I lean on the wall and watch you write
The air in this room is close
My jaw will not close

lines.zh: 黑暗浓一点，我就清楚一点
lines.en: The thicker the dark, the clearer I become
I am waiting for one glance up
You finally saw me
Keep looking at me, do not blink
Your pupils just narrowed
You want to turn, and you cannot
I am directly in front of you
This second belongs to me
You are screaming inside, I can hear it
You need not move, I will
My face is very close to yours
Do not shut your eyes, that is worse
Your breath stopped for half a beat

lines.zh: 这声音是从我喉咙里出来的
lines.en: That sound came from my throat

lines.zh: 你的手还举着，动不了吧
lines.en: Your hand is still raised, frozen
I cling to the corner behind you.

lines.zh: 看清楚，这是你今晚的梦
lines.en: Look closely, this is tonight's dream

lines.zh: 墙角的这张脸，刚长出来。
lines.en: This face in the corner just grew.
There is no way back, only wall

lines.zh: 我在你眼前，也只是在你眼前
lines.en: I am before your eyes, and only there
This image will stay a long time
Count to three, and I vanish
You actually hit me

lines.zh: 我在墙角对你笑了一下。
lines.en: In the corner, I smiled at you.

lines.zh: 墙角的这张脸，本来就该疼。
lines.en: The face in the corner was always meant to hurt.
My face went slightly crooked
You struck only air
I retreat into the shadow
My outline has faded
I am still here, do not worry
That changed nothing
You are still standing there, good

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只要你的注意
lines.en: I am not hungry, I want your attention

lines.zh: 你把灯举高，看我更清楚
lines.en: Raise the lamp, see me better
I will not take that

lines.zh: 你递东西的手在抖，我看得清。
lines.en: The hand offering me that is shaking; I see it clearly.
Put it down and look at me
This light is not enough to show all of me
I truly do not eat
The more you give, the closer I come

lines.zh: 拿开，你挡着自己的视线了
lines.en: Move it, you are blocking your own view

lines.zh: 这不是交易，是我在等你
lines.en: This is not a trade, I am simply waiting
You walked into me
My body is colder than it looks

lines.zh: 你退开时，我已经在别处
lines.en: When you pull back, I am elsewhere
Where you touched me goes numb
We overlapped for an instant
Your shoulder passed through my head
That was not a collision, that was a meeting
Back away, you are not ready

lines.zh: 我的手从你背后绕过来
lines.en: My hand comes around your back

lines.zh: 你转过来时，我就在原地
lines.en: When you turn, I am right where I was
Things like me do not come in pairs
Another face might be elsewhere
Two faces facing each other is too crowded
We only meet inside a stare
Kin to me is only a darker shadow

lines.zh: 一起出现会把屋子挤满
lines.en: Appearing together would fill the room
I am not lonely, I have all of you
Face to face, neither of us moves

lines.zh: 满月之夜，我们会凑得多些
lines.en: On full moons we gather more
That pair is enough to frighten a whole night
I reach, and I have no fingers

lines.zh: 东西从我手里穿过去了
lines.en: The thing passed through my hand
I do not pick up, I let it roll

lines.zh: 这东西在你这儿更安全
lines.en: This is safer with you
Dropped things are clear to me

lines.zh: 我从墙角挪出来一点，到你脚边。
lines.en: I ease out of the corner to your feet.
These things I won't even touch.
The sound of it landing is pleasant
Keep it, you will look for it later
I only take your attention
You looked up, so now
I have found your angle
This spot by the wall is best
There is nobody with you
My face is already arranged
You are looking elsewhere, perfect
This room is mine
I begin at the edge of your vision

lines.zh: 你的灯照不到这个角落
lines.en: Your lamp does not reach this corner
I approach, and you have not reacted
I have waited long for this moment
You are looking down, very good
One instant like this is enough
I have chosen this night
Next time you look up, you will regret it
Now it is my turn to make a sound

lines.zh: 我一直站在你视线的边缘
lines.en: I stay at the edge of your vision

lines.zh: 你看墙的时候我在墙上
lines.en: When you look at the wall, I am on it
Your lamp flickered
A little closer and I can make a sound
You look back, and I am gone

lines.zh: 我在等你一个人的时候
lines.en: I wait for when you are alone
The shadows here are deep enough

lines.zh: 我的脚步声和你的重叠
lines.en: My footsteps overlap yours
What you heard was not imagination
I retreat along your line of sight

lines.zh: 你走到走廊尽头就麻烦了
lines.en: Reach the end of the hall and you are in trouble

lines.zh: 空气里的冷是我带来的
lines.en: The cold in the air came with me
I have been three steps behind you all along
You should not have lit that candle
The shadow moves first, then I do
You stopped in order to listen
The sound is getting closer
I know your name
One more turn of your head is enough
I am already against your back
My hand passes through your chest

lines.zh: 这一下没有伤口，只有冷
lines.en: This leaves no wound, only cold
Your vision is filled by me
I clamp down on your shoulder
Being unable to move is normal

lines.zh: 这一声从很近的地方来
lines.en: That sound came from very near
My hand has no weight
You are shaking, good
You will remember this one a long time
I do not bite, I only need to touch
I press down on your breath
That grab landed on your nape
I breathe right against your ear.

lines.zh: 我贴到你脸前，一动不动。
lines.en: I press close to your face and go still.
Your hand comes up too slowly
That is enough, look no more

lines.zh: 角落里的影子动了一下
lines.en: The shadow in the corner shifted
I rise out of the wall

lines.zh: 这一间屋子的黑暗够用
lines.en: The dark in this room is enough

lines.zh: 你没有看见我怎么来的
lines.en: You did not see how I arrived
First, a whisper
I take shape at the edge of your sight

lines.zh: 满月的夜里我会更常来
lines.en: On full moon nights I come more often
I turn slowly toward you

lines.zh: 地板响了一声，然后是我
lines.en: The floor creaked, and then came I

lines.zh: 这间屋子里多了一张脸
lines.en: One more face in this room

lines.zh: 我在门后等着，被看见了
lines.en: I waited behind the door, and was seen
My appearing needs no reason
In the instant the lamp died, I was there

lines.zh: 你的影子旁边多了个影子
lines.en: A second shadow joins yours
I come down slowly from the ceiling
I made no sound when I appeared

lines.zh: 你还没回头，我已经在你面前
lines.en: You have not turned, and I am before you

lines.zh: 这是你今晚第一次看见我
lines.en: This is the first time you see me tonight
The air grew cold, that was me arriving

lines.zh: 我看着你，从最暗的地方
lines.en: I watch you from the darkest place

lines.zh: 火照亮了我，也烫到了我
lines.en: Fire lit me up and burned me too

lines.zh: 我从墙上掉下来，形状散了
lines.en: I fall from the wall and lose my shape

lines.zh: 水灌进来，我的低语停了
lines.en: Water rushes in and my whisper stops

lines.zh: 爆炸的亮光让我无所遁形
lines.en: The blast's light leaves me nowhere to hide

lines.zh: 飞来的东西穿过了我的脸
lines.en: Something flying went through my face
That force pins me to the wall
I do not hunger, I simply fade
Lightning lit the whole room
There are no corners in the void
